pr_body:
Fixes #48021 

Release note (cli change): `debug zip` now properly skips over fully
decommissioned nodes.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/48073)
Just tweaked the code to issue a separate `admin.Liveness()` call because the liveness field in `NodesResponse` is 20.1-only and I want this to work on mixed 19.x-20.x clusters.

issue_context.title: cli: make `debug zip` skip over known deco+dead nodes
issue_context.body:
The code for `cockroach gen haproxy` already does this. `debug zip` should do the same.

Requested by @jasobrown
comments: Having to wait for `debug zip` to skip over decommissioned nodes is a huge problem when trying to grab logs from production clusters that are having problems. It's guaranteed block time, on the order of tens of minutes depending on the size of the cluster, for operators who need to investigate a troubled cluster. Would love to see this resolved quickly.

review_comments: Why not use SQL? This Override can be wiped out by an ill-timed gossip update.
